statement.document_title: The AI Industry Is Lying To You

from_speaker: NVIDIA is selling GPUs years into the future
grow, or even just maintain its current revenues
convince people that this is somehow rational
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that maintaining NVIDIA's revenue level requires customers to keep accepting GPU purchases for deployment years ahead.
This is a claim of necessary dependence, not merely that advance purchases contribute to revenue.
For a numerical revenue baseline, use the latest reported quarter before publication: fiscal Q4 2026, ending January 25, 2026. The speaker supplies no amount or accounting basis.
Advance orders, recognized revenue, delivery and actual deployment must be distinguished.
criteria.support_condition: Customer contracts, deployment schedules and revenue attribution establish multiyear advance purchases and show that NVIDIA could not maintain its current revenue level without customers accepting those purchases.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that NVIDIA can maintain or increase the baseline revenue without the asserted dependence on purchases years ahead of deployment. A few promptly deployed purchases alone would not establish this.
